claim: Roannais hosts five officially labeled Villages de Caractère en Loire: Saint-Haon-le-Châtel, Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire, Ambierle, Perreux and Le Crozet.
quote: Saint-Haon-le-Châtel is one of the five villages labeled 'Village of Character in the Loire' of Roannais, alongside Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire, Ambierle, Perreux and Le Crozet.

claim: The Benedictine Abbey of Charlieu, founded c.875 and attached to Cluny in the 10th century, sits about 25 minutes north of Roanne and is Charlieu's main anchor sight.
quote: Benedictine Abbey in Charlieu, 25 minutes from Roanne ... Founded around 875, the Benedictine abbey of Charlieu was attached in the middle of the 10th century to the great Burgundian abbey of Cluny.

claim: Charlieu Benedictine Abbey admission is 5€ full, 4€ reduced, free under 12; a guided tour adds 3€.
quote: Full price: €5. Reduced rate: €4 (ages 12-18, students, job seekers, disabled persons). Free entry for children under 12 ... Guided tours supplement: €3 additional.

claim: Charlieu's outdoor market runs Wednesday and Saturday mornings on Boulevard Jacquard, a tradition dating back to a 1207 charter.
quote: The market is held on Wednesday mornings on Boulevard Jacquard ... On Saturday mornings, there is also a market ... a market had already been taking place each Wednesday and Saturday since 1207.

claim: The Cordeliers Convent in Saint-Nizier-sous-Charlieu has one of the few preserved medieval Franciscan cloisters in France, with a Rayonnant Gothic north gallery whose capitals depict vices and virtues.
quote: The cloister of the Cordeliers convent is one of the few medieval Franciscan cloisters still preserved in France ... in the Rayonnant Gothic style, ... north gallery adorned with figurative capitals humorously depicting vices and virtues.

claim: Ambierle Priory, 18 km from Roanne, houses a 5-meter Flemish altarpiece (1466) with paintings attributed to Rogier van der Weyden and a sculpted Passion of Christ.
quote: located north of the Loire department, 18 km from Roanne ... An altarpiece dated 1466 ... paintings attributed to the great Flemish painter Rogier van der Weyden ... polyptych, which extends over 5 meters.

claim: Saint-Haon-le-Châtel, 14th-century capital of Roannais, retains a moated enclosure with 18 towers and four gates — the only Loire commune to preserve this medieval configuration — plus a medieval garden and Romanesque church.
quote: the only commune in Loire to have retained this medieval configuration. The fortifications feature a moated enclosure with eighteen towers and four gates ... medieval garden featuring more than one hundred plants ... Romanesque church with magnificent restored medieval wall paintings.

claim: Le Crozet, one of Roanne's four medieval strongholds, holds a 12th-century dungeon, 13th-century Maison de Bois, the listed Grande Porte and a Museum of Popular Arts and Traditions in a 16th-century turreted house.
quote: houses from the 13th, 15th and 16th centuries ... the great gate (a listed Historical Monument), the Maison de Bois (Wooden House) from the 13th century ... Dungeon from the 12th century ... Museum of Popular Arts and Traditions in a 15th century house with a corner turret.

claim: La Pacaudière, ~25 minutes from Roanne, preserves the Grande Porte of a fortified enclosure, half-timbered Maison du Connétable, arcaded Halle de la Cordouannerie and the Petit Louvre, a Gothic-Renaissance hybrid listed since 1932.
quote: La Pacaudière has 1000 inhabitants and is located 25 minutes from Roanne ... pass under the Grande Porte ... Maison du Connétable with half-timbered walls ... The iconic Petit Louvre, a building from the early 16th century classified as a historic monument since July 1932.

claim: Priory of Pommiers-en-Forez, ~30 minutes from Roanne, has four massive towers, was preserved through the Revolution, has been Loire-département-owned since 1990, and is accessible only by guided tour.
quote: Priory of Pommiers in Pommiers-en-Forez, 30 minutes from Roanne ... With its four massive towers ... preserved by its successive owners until the site was acquired by the Loire department in 1990 ... accessible to the public, only by guided tour.

claim: Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire perches over the Loire on the Cluny/Le Puy pilgrimage route; the 17 m Tour de Saint-Maurice keep gives a 360° view over the Villerest dam, and artisan workshops (pottery, foundry) plus a Sunday summer market enliven the village July–August.
quote: The keep called Tour de Saint-Maurice ... dominates the village from its 17 meters and offers a 360° panorama over the waters of the dam ... Every Sunday morning between July and August, the village offers a summer market.

claim: Perreux became the 5th Roannais Village de Caractère in 2022; sights include a remnant castle tower, an 11th-century chapel, fortified gate, two flamboyant Gothic chapels and around 15 half-timbered houses from the 15th–16th centuries.
quote: Perreux became, in 2022, the 5e Village of Character in Roannais ... There remains of the castle the tower, a chapel of the XIe century and the old fortified gate ... two chapels in flamboyant Gothic style ... Around fifteen half-timbered houses date from the 15th and 16th century.
